text:
maya: Quick sync 1  MosaicHealth agreed to a short written Q&A + 30m interview TOMORROW 9:00am PT. Need legal on quotes, logo permission, and an embargo window. Also want webinar signups routed to an SDR queue 'mosaic-webinar'.

ethan: I'll handle recording and request separate takes for social clips. Can someone paste the quote candidates so legal can pre-check?

carol: Draft release: one-paragraph permission + checkbox on calendar. If they mention % savings, legal will want a metrics snapshot. If they won't share numbers, we can use terms like "measurable reduction".

devon: Demand gen notes: suggest utm_campaign=mosaic-launch and a dedicated landing page. We'll webhook signups to Salesforce to queue "Mosaic Webinar". Need 1 long quote for blog and 2 short lines for social.

maya: Copying verbatim snippets from the demo call (will confirm on mic):
"Moving inference to Redwood Dedicated cut our tail latency from around 280ms to ~170ms during heavy traffic."
"Using Redwood's batching and KV cache reduced GPU spend on session flows by about 38% in our internal tests."
"Deployment was effortless  our team kept the feature live without rollbacks."

ethan: Good. I'll capture each line as a separate take and attach consent language to the invite.

carol: Flagging the ~38% claim  we need either a dashboard snapshot or a signed confirmation. Also customer prefers we not publish their logo without a signed logo release. They are fine with name + quotes if they sign the release.

devon: Sample webhook payload for ops (auth token omitted):
POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "mosaic-webinar",
  "email": "{registrant_email}",
  "first_name": "{registrant_first}",
  "last_name": "{registrant_last}",
  "utm_campaign": "mosaic-launch",
  "target_queue": "Mosaic Webinar"
}

maya: Customer requested embargo: earliest publish 2026-08-03 08:00 PT. Can legal sign off by 7/30 EOD?

carol: That timeline works if we get the metrics confirmation and signed release by 7/30. I'll draft the release now and send to maya for signature flow.

ethan: Calendar invite "MosaicHealth case interview" scheduled and recording enabled. I'll upload raw video + transcript after.

ops-bot: Calendar invite "MosaicHealth case interview" created by ethan for 2026-07-27 09:00 PT. Recording enabled.

devon: I'll build the landing page placeholder and wire the SFDC webhook to a test queue. Will add utm params and a confirmation email + 24h reminder cadence.

maya: Perfect. Next steps checklist: 1) customer confirms metrics snapshot (owner: mosaic infra), 2) legal signs release & quote text (owner: carol), 3) logo release signed or anonymize (owner: maya), 4) landing page live + webhook tested (owner: devon), 5) recording + timestamps uploaded (owner: ethan). Tag me when done. :rocket:
